Insurance support

Start with the plan, clinician, and service you intend to use.

M.F.T. currently works with Premera, Aetna, Regence, and Cigna. Network participation and benefits can vary by clinician, service, and individual plan, so verification is required before relying on coverage.

In-network plans

Premera · Aetna · Regence · Cigna

Participation can vary by clinician and plan.

Out-of-network

Ask our support team whether a superbill is available for your service and what information your plan may require for reimbursement.

Couples services

Couples consultations and couples sessions are private pay. Do not assume an individual psychotherapy benefit applies to couples work.

Request a benefits check

Email support@mft.care to begin. The email asks for your name, best phone number, carrier, clinician if known, service, and preferred format. Do not email insurance member numbers, dates of birth, diagnoses, or other sensitive clinical information. We will send the appropriate secure next step for anything else needed.
